Additional file 8 for "Gene conversion and purifying selection shape nucleotide variation in gibbon L/M opsin genes" by T. Hiwatashi et al.

A "sequential" (fasta) format of the sequence alignments for the gibbon S opsin gene intron 4.

Species name abbreviations:
Hag, Hylobates agilis; Hla, H. lar; Hpi, H. pileatus; Nle, Nomascus leucogenys; Ssy, Symphalangus syndactylus.

Sequence names can be interpreted as in the following examples.
In 1_Hag_S_2, 1 stands for individual ID number, Hag for Hylobates agilis, S for S opsin, 2 for a tentative allele sequence 2.
